[[Forced Measure]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Hello. Tell me, are you feeling healthy? There's been talk of some kind of disease, either from the Lab or somewhere else. I even had a "witness" come in, clearly gone mental. He told me about the living dead who bleed themselves and hunt people. I tell you what, I've heard many such tales before. Yet the man's grayed hair and that look in his eyes... He's definitely seen something sinister. Maybe some looters mutilated a corpse for fun, or some poor bastard spilled acid on himself. In any case, I think you should look into that story. You know how panic spreads around this place.}} ==Objectives== * Locate the source of rumors of the living dead in [[The Lab]] * Find a way inside the quarantined section in [[The Lab]] ==Rewards== * +7,000 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.01''' * 36,000 Roubles ** 37,800 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 41,400 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[Paracord]] {{quote|I cannot believe it! So the madman was telling the truth? If it's connected to TerraGroup and their experiments, it's bad news. It seems that someone has opened the Lab from the inside, disrupted all the security, and now anyone can get in and out of there. Take care of yourself and get ready for some serious footwork. Tarkov is in great danger.}} ==Guide== To complete the first part of this quest, you need to walk in front of the locked door to the laboratories in the containment block on the first level of [[The Lab]].
